operative_wording.source_excerpt_summary: If Base Sum Insured plus accumulated Super Credit is completely exhausted or insufficient for covering a claim, Super Reload equal to Base Sum Insured is provided unlimited times during the Policy Year, subject to listed conditions. The clause states first-claim availability is controlled by the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table, caps single-claim Super Reload liability at Base Sum Insured, excludes Super Reload from Super Credit calculation, and specifies the utilization sequence Base SI -> Super Credit -> Super Reload -> Cancer Booster.

product_benefit_table.source_excerpt_summary: Super Reload (Unlimited Refill): From 2nd claim of Policy Life - Unlimited times.

first_claim_rule.corroboration: Product Benefit Table states From 2nd claim of Policy Life - Unlimited times.

same_triggering_claim_use.basis: The trigger includes insufficiency for covering a claim and the utilization sequence places Super Reload inside the same claim capacity stack after Base SI and Super Credit.

historical_anchor_control.note: Historical Activ One NXT implementation was used only as a locator for what to inspect. Every semantic in this record is independently re-derived from current 38bb source wording.

material_shape_difference: Bajaj current rule restricts reinstatement consumption to a subsequent claim; Activ One current rule permits same-triggering-claim participation when available capacity is insufficient.
Bajaj current rule has SI-banded recurrence; Activ One current rule is unlimited during policy year without those SI recurrence bands.
Activ One current rule explicitly composes Base SI, Super Credit, Super Reload and Cancer Booster in an ordered utilization sequence.
cross_insurer_pressure.conclusion: Current-source evidence is sufficient to test real cross-insurer restoration evaluator portability. The utilization sequence creates a separate composition/ordering pressure that must remain bounded and not be silently generalized.

explicit_scope_boundaries: This record does not decide claim payment or admissibility outside the listed governed conditions.

Cancer Booster ordering and Super Credit interaction are current-source facts, but a general composition engine is outside this qualification artifact.
